description:
How many cars households keep: dwellings with no vehicle, one, two, three or four or more, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 10,700 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/motor-vehicles`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_occupied_dwellings, no_vehicle_count, no_vehicle_pct, one_vehicle_count, one_vehicle_pct, two_vehicles_count, two_vehicles_pct, three_vehicles_count, three_vehicles_pct, four_plus_vehicles_count, four_plus_vehicles_pct, two_or_more_vehicles_count, two_or_more_vehicles_pct, vehicles_not_stated_count, vehicles_not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_area_stats_motor_vehicles
title: Suburb · Motor vehicles per dwelling
